coverage_error.estimator: mean +/- two-sided normal SE across replicates

free_energy_final.estimator: mean +/- two-sided normal SE across replicates

paired_loglik_diff.estimator: paired mean difference (informative vs identity transition) at common random numbers

posterior_accuracy.estimator: mean +/- two-sided normal SE across replicates

mean_exactness_residual.estimator: mean +/- two-sided normal SE across replicates
mean_exactness_residual.sample_unit: replicate (max across atom-count arms within the replicate)

refinement_paired_diff.estimator: paired mean difference of |projected mean - raw mean| between the largest and smallest atom counts on identical laws

huber_fd_residual.estimator: mean +/- two-sided normal SE across replicates

completeness_residual.estimator: mean +/- two-sided normal SE across replicates

exp_calibration_atom_gap_max.interpretation: Largest per-replicate exact target gap F(Q(tau)) from the nominal level (descriptive atom-discretization gap).

exp_calibration_atom_gap_mean.interpretation: Mean exact gap F(Q(tau)) - tau from the nominal level, an inherent property of quantile atoms on discrete laws, not an error.

exp_calibration_coverage_error_max_repli.interpretation: Largest per-replicate deviation from the exact discrete-law target.

exp_calibration_coverage_error_mean.interpretation: Mean |empirical coverage - exact discrete-law target F(Q(tau))| per level, averaged over replicates; validates the coverage diagnostic against the exact null, not the nominal level.

exp_calibration_coverage_error_mean_ci95.interpretation: Upper bound of the 0.95 interval for exp_calibration_coverage_error_mean.
Lower bound of the 0.95 interval for exp_calibration_coverage_error_mean.

exp_calibration_level_target_gap_max.interpretation: Largest per-level gap between mean observed coverage and the mean exact target across replicates.

exp_filter_closed_form_residual_max.interpretation: Max deviation of the filter trajectory from the exact repeated-Bayes closed form q_k proportional to prior * likelihood^(k+1).

exp_filter_free_energy_final_mean.interpretation: Mean final variational free energy after the configured filter updates.

exp_filter_free_energy_final_mean_ci95_h.interpretation: Upper bound of the 0.95 interval for exp_filter_free_energy_final_mean.

exp_filter_free_energy_final_mean_ci95_l.interpretation: Lower bound of the 0.95 interval for exp_filter_free_energy_final_mean.

exp_filter_paired_loglik_diff_mean.interpretation: Paired mean log P(true role) difference: informative minus identity transition, same draws.

exp_filter_paired_loglik_diff_mean_ci95_.interpretation: Upper bound of the 0.95 interval for exp_filter_paired_loglik_diff_mean.
Lower bound of the 0.95 interval for exp_filter_paired_loglik_diff_mean.

exp_filter_posterior_accuracy_mean.interpretation: Mean P(true role) after the configured assimilations with the identity transition.

exp_filter_posterior_accuracy_mean_ci95_.interpretation: Upper bound of the 0.95 interval for exp_filter_posterior_accuracy_mean.
Lower bound of the 0.95 interval for exp_filter_posterior_accuracy_mean.

exp_filter_posterior_mode_match_rate.interpretation: Descriptive fraction of replicates whose posterior mode is the true role; replicate indicators are not identically distributed, so no pooled binomial interval is attached.

exp_projection_clipping_effect_mean.interpretation: Mean |projected mean - unclipped mean|; the support-truncation effect.

exp_projection_mass_residual_max.interpretation: Max |sum of projected atom masses - 1| across replicates and atom counts.

exp_projection_mean_exactness_residual_m.interpretation: Mean |projected mean - mean of clipped quantile samples|; the projection is mean-exact by construction.
exp_projection_mean_exactness_residual_m.sample_unit: replicate (max across atom-count arms within the replicate)

exp_projection_mean_exactness_residual_m.interpretation: Upper bound of the 0.95 interval for exp_projection_mean_exactness_residual_mean.
exp_projection_mean_exactness_residual_m.sample_unit: replicate (max across atom-count arms within the replicate)

exp_projection_mean_exactness_residual_m.interpretation: Lower bound of the 0.95 interval for exp_projection_mean_exactness_residual_mean.
exp_projection_mean_exactness_residual_m.sample_unit: replicate (max across atom-count arms within the replicate)

exp_projection_refinement_paired_diff_me.interpretation: Paired clipping-effect difference between the largest and smallest configured atom counts on identical laws (~0 when exact).
Upper bound of the 0.95 interval for exp_projection_refinement_paired_diff_mean.
Lower bound of the 0.95 interval for exp_projection_refinement_paired_diff_mean.

exp_quantile_bruteforce_w1_crossing_resi.interpretation: Absolute W1 discrepancy against trapezoidal integration for crossing quantile curves.

exp_quantile_bruteforce_w1_residual_max.interpretation: Max |closed-form W1 - trapezoidal integral on the knot-refined grid|.

exp_quantile_huber_fd_residual_max.interpretation: Largest such finite-difference deviation across replicates.

exp_quantile_huber_fd_residual_mean.interpretation: Mean max deviation of quantile_td_update from a finite-difference gradient step of the asymmetric-Huber objective.

exp_quantile_huber_fd_residual_mean_ci95.interpretation: Upper bound of the 0.95 interval for exp_quantile_huber_fd_residual_mean.
Lower bound of the 0.95 interval for exp_quantile_huber_fd_residual_mean.

exp_quantile_wasserstein_selfdistance_ma.interpretation: Max Wasserstein self-distance over identical laws (must be ~0).

exp_quantile_wasserstein_shift_residual_.interpretation: Max |W_p(shifted grid law) - shift| across replicates.

exp_quantile_wasserstein_triangle_violat.interpretation: Max triangle-inequality violation for W1 on random quantile triplets.

exp_quantum_completeness_residual_mean.interpretation: Mean |sum of Born-rule probabilities - 1| under the crisp two-role POVM.

exp_quantum_completeness_residual_mean_c.interpretation: Upper bound of the 0.95 interval for exp_quantum_completeness_residual_mean.
Lower bound of the 0.95 interval for exp_quantum_completeness_residual_mean.

exp_sanity_analytic_identities_pass.interpretation: 1 = all analytic identity controls passed; 0 = at least one failed (see experiments.sanity.controls for the named failures).

exp_sanity_invalid_input_controls_pass.interpretation: 1 = every invalid-input control was rejected by the source modules; 0 = at least one invalid input was accepted.

exp_sensitivity_entropy_bins_max_abs_eff.interpretation: Descriptive largest paired effect of the prespecified return-entropy bin-count sweep against bins[0]; discretization sensitivity of the diagnostic; carries NO interval (all arms reported with pointwise intervals in experiments.sensitivity.arms).

exp_sensitivity_gamma_max_abs_effect.interpretation: Descriptive largest paired mean-score effect of the prespecified gamma sweep against gamma[0] at common random numbers; carries NO interval because the arm is selected by the data (prespecified per-arm pointwise intervals are in experiments.sensitivity.arms).

exp_sensitivity_temperature_max_abs_effe.interpretation: Descriptive largest paired effect of the prespecified policy-temperature sweep against temperatures[0] on the policy entropy; carries NO interval (all arms reported with pointwise intervals in experiments.sensitivity.arms).
